subtitle: Lesson 19 · Incident Response for Platform Issues

code:
"The whole instance is slow"

  Could mean:                      Looks identical from:
  - genuine platform-wide event    - every user's chair
  - one loud, widely-used feature  - the same first report

  Triage's job: tell them apart BEFORE committing to a fix
caption: A shared slow feature feels universal even when nothing else is affected.

steps.label: 1. Confirm scope
steps.sub: Instance Health Dashboard — is it actually instance-wide?

steps.label: 2. Check deployment
steps.sub: did a release go out right before reports started?

steps.label: 3. Check resources
steps.sub: semaphore or node exhaustion from a runaway job or capacity

code:
Bad deployment      -> roll back / fix the change
Runaway job          -> kill or reschedule the job
Capacity exhaustion  -> address infrastructure capacity

All three LOOK the same to users. Evidence decides which one it is.
caption: Each real cause demands a different response — guessing picks the wrong one.

subtitle: When the evidence points past what an admin can fix alone.
